name: Visit Yogyakarta
description: Yogyakarta Special Region Tourism Office — official information on Keraton tours, Prambanan and Borobudur access, batik workshops, gamelan events, and the Ramayana ballet schedule.

name: Keraton Yogyakarta
description: The Sultan's living palace — opened to visitors since 1973. Opening hours, gamelan and wayang performance schedule, group tour bookings, and cultural protocol information (dress code, photography rules).

name: Taman Sari Water Castle
description: The Sultan's 18th-century pleasure garden — bathing pools, underground mosque, and royal apartments. Guided tour availability, opening hours (06:00–14:00), and sarong rental information.

name: Candi Prambanan
description: Southeast Asia's largest Hindu temple complex — ticket booking, Ramayana open-air ballet schedule (full-moon nights), group rates, and access information for the broader compound (Candi Sewu, Candi Plaosan).

name: Borobudur Heritage Tourism
description: The world's largest Buddhist monument, 40km from Yogyakarta. Sunrise ticket booking (limited to 1,000/day), general admission, guided tour packages, and the Manohara Hotel on-site for dawn access.

name: Grand Inna Malioboro
description: Heritage hotel directly on Jalan Malioboro — the most central address in the city. Concierge services for Merapi treks, Keraton tours, and batik workshop bookings. Restaurant and room reservations.

name: Malioboro Tourist Information
description: Walk-in tourist centre on Jalan Malioboro with free maps, batik shopping guides, becak fare charts, and information on Kraton and Taman Sari access. Staff speak English and Mandarin.
